name: Szerecseny (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szerecseny (a shield with a church, houses, a sun and a crescent, with ears of grain) between the name SZERECSENY above and the year 1997 below in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
